name: HORIZONTAL PLANETARY BALL MILL
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-HPBM-8L Horizontal Planetary Ball Mill is specifically engineered for advanced research laboratories to prevent materials from sinking or sticking to the bottom of the grinding jar. Used for challenging synthetic materials, this horizontal design ensures superior fineness and homogenization while adopting high-speed planetary movement with large energy impact.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Horizontal Planetary Ball Mill operates on the principle of high-energy impact and friction generated by the planetary motion of grinding jars mounted horizontally on a sun wheel. The jars rotate around their own axis in the opposite direction to the sun wheel's rotation, creating strong centrifugal and Coriolis forces that accelerate the grinding balls to high velocities. This horizontal configuration prevents material from sinking or sticking to the bottom of the jar, ensuring uniform grinding and homogenization even for challenging synthetic materials. The mill is widely used by doctors, B.Sc/M.Sc students, PhD researchers, and chemists for mechanical alloying, synthesis of nanomaterials, and preparation of advanced ceramics, metal oxides, carbides, and nitrides. It is also employed for cell disruption of biological samples, such as plant tissues and microbial cultures, and for grinding of strong acids and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in sealed jars under inert atmosphere. The process adheres to international testing standards such as ASTM B822 for particle size distribution and ISO 13320 for laser diffraction analysis, ensuring reproducible and reliable results in advanced materials research and synthetic chemistry.
sop: Ensure the Horizontal Planetary Ball Mill is placed on a stable, level surface and connected to a properly grounded power supply.
Select appropriate grinding jars and balls made of compatible materials (e.g., SS304/316, agate, zirconia, tungsten carbide) based on the sample's hardness and chemical reactivity.
Load the sample material and grinding balls into each jar, ensuring the jar is not more than two-thirds full to allow efficient movement.
Seal the jars tightly with their lids and safety clamps to prevent leakage during operation.
Mount the jars symmetrically on the sun wheel, distributing equal weight on opposite positions to maintain balance.
Close the safety cover completely; the integrated safety switch will prevent operation if the cover is open.
Turn on the main power switch and wait for the control panel to initialize.
Press the 'SET' button once to enter the parameter setting mode for speed or time.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., revolution speed in rpm or total grinding time in minutes).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and exit the setting mode.
If needed, set the alternate running time for forward and reverse rotation by repeating the SET and arrow key sequence for the secondary parameter.
Press the 'START' button to begin the grinding process; monitor the operation for any unusual vibrations or noises.
After the set time elapses, the mill will stop automatically; wait for the sun wheel to come to a complete halt before opening the safety cover.
Carefully remove the jars, open them in a fume hood if volatile or hazardous materials were processed, and collect the ground sample.
Clean the jars and balls thoroughly with appropriate solvents and dry them before storage.

Safety Warning: Never open the safety cover while the mill is running; always ensure jars are symmetrically loaded and balanced to prevent catastrophic failure, and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, gloves, and a lab coat when handling hazardous or reactive materials.
features: Horizontal design prevents material from sinking or sticking to the bottom
Imported frequency converter precisely controls speed and protects the motor
Adjustable time of forward, reverse rotation, and alternation functions
Maximum four powder samples from different materials can be ground simultaneously
Integrated safety switch stops the machine if the lid is opened while running

specifications.MOC of Jar & Balls: SS304/316, Agate, Nylon, Corundum, Zirconia, Tungsten Carbide
specifications.Target Applications: Advanced Materials Research, Synthetic Chemistry, Nanomaterials
